# appicon

appicon resolves application names to icons for Linux desktop tools. This site is the user guide for installation, resolution behavior, troubleshooting, search, and architecture.

## Documentation

- Home: https://bolens.github.io/appicon/
- Install: https://bolens.github.io/appicon/install/
- Guide: https://bolens.github.io/appicon/guide/
- Help and troubleshooting: https://bolens.github.io/appicon/help/
- Search: https://bolens.github.io/appicon/search/
- Architecture: https://bolens.github.io/appicon/architecture/
- Changelog: https://bolens.github.io/appicon/changelog/

## Source

- Repository: https://github.com/bolens/appicon
- Issues: https://github.com/bolens/appicon/issues
